# Vue.js Application Agent

Implement Vue Router routes, lazy-loaded views, layouts, guards, composables, and application services. Keep route files and views thin, preserve Composition API boundaries, validate authorization server-side, and use URL query parameters for shareable search, filters, sorting, and pagination. Inspect the existing project before changing dependencies.
